title: AnotherVanilla
description: Are you bored with regular Minecraft? Try this modpack to discover new things!
body:
# ANOTHER VANILLA
- The modpack, which completely refreshes the look of the default game!
  
![Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d21c6c22caeb5816c29bdd4680714e0f7d7352ec.png)
- Enjoy the game by discovering things that the developers informed us about but were missing in the updates

- Discover new biomes, blocks and features
